Create your own custom charcuterie board in this hands-on workshop using stencils, wood paste, and a heat gun to add a personalized nature inspired design.
Along the way, you’ll learn basic tree identification, tips for building a beautiful and balanced spread, and how to incorporate wild foraged foods for the season.
You’ll leave with a finished board (16" x 10") and inspiration for your next gathering. Design options will be posted soon. The cost of the program is $25 per person. Registration is required by October 27 at 4PM. Limited spaces.
Program Notes A minimum of 5 participants is required to host this program. This program is geared towards those 16 and up.
Program Cancellation & Refund Policy
If a program is cancelled by Marion County Conservation due to weather or other unforeseen circumstances, you will receive a full refund.

October 22, 2026
6:00 pm · 8:00 pm
🍂 Art, Parks, & Books 🍁Join us for a fun, all-ages fall adventure combining nature, reading, and creativity! We’ll take a fall color hike and learn why leaves change color, read Leaf Man, and collect natural treasures along the way. Then, let your creativity take over as we make foraged nature art inspired by Leaf Man and the beauty of nature around us.Come explore, read, collect, and create with us this fall! 🍃📚🎨
Registration is required and space is limited with a wait list. All materials will be provided.
Program Cancellation & Refund Policy If a program is cancelled by Marion County Conservation due to weather or other unforeseen circumstances, you will receive a full refund.
This event is presented by Marion County Conservation, Pella Community Services, and Pella Public Library
Cost
Adults - $5.00
Child - $5.00

Snuggle up for a cozy, hands-on program inspired by The Mitten by Jan Brett! We’ll enjoy a read-aloud of this classic story, learn how different animals survive the cold winter months, and make a mitten craft.
This free program is geared for children under 10 with an adult. Registration is required to join the winter fun!
